description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ImportViewDupcheck' which manages the user interface for step 1 of an import process, specifically for duplicate checking, in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering the view, generating JavaScript for the import process, and handling user interactions related to duplicate detection during data import.

classes.name: ImportViewDupcheck
classes.description: A view handler class for the duplicate check step in the import process, extending the ImportView class, responsible for rendering UI and managing JavaScript related to duplicate checking during import.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the duplicate check import step view, including assigning variables to the template and fetching content for display.

methods.name: getImportMap
methods.description: Retrieves the current import mapping if a source ID is provided.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code used in the view to handle the import process, including file splitting, duplicate detection UI, and asynchronous submission.
